  Fundamentals of Machine Learning [CSE_3127]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                With the help of a neat diagram, represent both hard-margin and soft-margin Support Vector               (5)  
  Machines (SVMs).  
  A)           i)Analyse how the optimization formulation changes when moving from a hard-margin SVM to a  
  soft-margin SVM.  
  ii)Explain the role of slack variables (ξᵢ) and the regularization parameter (C) in controlling margin  
  violations.  
  iii) Support your answer with a suitable illustrative example showing how varying C affects the  
  decision boundary and misclassifications.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Explain the process of Boosting using a diagram and stepwise flow. Analyse how successive weak           (3)  
  learners reduce bias and improve overall model accuracy.

  can be extracted from it. Explain how the placement of attributes near the root impacts  
  A)           interpretability and generalization of the resulting rule set.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Illustrate the Random Forest algorithm with a diagram and explain the key steps involved in training (3)  
  and combining multiple trees. Analyze how Random Forest overcomes overfitting compared to a  
  single decision tree.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Analyse how the bias-variance trade-off affects a model's generalization ability. Explain how high       (3)  
  bias and high variance manifest as underfitting and overfitting respectively, using suitable  
  examples.
